capabilities: Gather memos, todos, and projects on one dashboard
Organize files with folder and database sections
Manage projects with kanban and gantt views
Track habits, reading, and expenses via widgets
Embed web pages, RSS feeds, and a media library
extras: All-in-one suite: dashboard, tasks, projects, calendar, RSS reader, web-page embedding, media library, 13 themes, and AI-agent skill dispatch. Includes a companion Chrome extension (Apex Clipper) and a Buy Me a Coffee donation page. Some features are desktop-only or need external accounts/keys (NetEase, WeChat Read, TickTick, AI agents). Data lives in a plain-text dashboard.md; NetEase login credentials stay in a local Electron session and are not written to config or synced. Requires Obsidian v0.15.0+; license 0BSD.
problem: Obsidian users must jump between separate notes and plugins to see their tasks, projects, files, and daily information together.

relations.evidence: 无需另外安装 Dataview 插件
启用 Claudian、Copilot 等插件或安装对应桌面应用

在桌面端搜索歌曲或导入网易云歌单
配套 Chrome 插件 Apex Clipper 上架

requires.name: 微信读书 (WeChat Read) API key
网易云音乐 (NetEase Cloud Music) account
AI agent app (Claudian, Copilot, Codex Desktop, ZCode, WorkBuddy)

summary: All-in-one dashboard workbench that gathers memos, todos, projects, files, calendar, RSS, and widgets onto one customizable page.
